notes: Paper uses 35k iterations on Mip-NeRF 360 (Sec. 5.1). Cap is set automatically from the scene name (paper Table 2 MCMC counts: bicycle 5.9M, counter 1.2M). Fisher pass at step 30000 reloads the train images (~20 s + a few GB of host RAM).
